name: Gerben-Jan Gerbrandy - § 138/2
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text: ‘notes that Parliament’s administration has requested clarification from the PfE Group; notes that the discharge authority has not yet been informed but expects to be informed without delay of any further developments and of the outcome of the administrative follow-up in this matter;’
